_meta.title: TriageWiseProdrome — base-rate rendering cases (req R3)
_meta.validates: TriageService._render_base_rate(chief_complaint) -> str | None, using the REAL condition_reference table (seed from condition_reference.csv).
_meta.nature: INTEGRATION. Seed condition_reference from the shipped CSV, call with a ChiefComplaint value, assert the exact line (or None).
_meta.seed_source: condition_reference.csv (complaint_key values are ChiefComplaint enum values: cardiac, respiratory, stroke, syncope, abdominal).
conventions: Complaint match: WHERE complaint_key == chief_complaint (a ChiefComplaint value).
Dangerous subset only if matched row has context_condition AND a row exists WHERE condition == context_condition.
Always appends ' Population reference, not this patient's probability.'

low-n: matched complaint row reliable == 'low-n (<30)' -> append ' Small sample, illustrative only.' (NOTE: no COMPLAINT row in the shipped CSV is low-n; only diagnosis rows 10/11 are, and those are never the complaint match - so the low-n branch is currently unreachable via complaint matching. Flag if you intend a low-n complaint.)

cases._why: chief_complaint 'cardiac' matches row 1 (Chest pain, context_condition=Acute MI). Row 3 (Acute MI) supplies the dangerous-subset rate. Robert's case.

expect.base_rate_line: Illustrative base rate (NHAMCS 2022): Chest pain (all causes) -> 13.7% admitted. Dangerous subset (Acute MI) -> 70.3%, not identifiable at triage. Population reference, not this patient's probability.

cases._note: Real CSV: row1 admit_rate 0.1373 -> 13.7%; row3 Acute MI 0.7031 -> 70.3%.

cases._why: 'respiratory' matches row 6 (SOB, context=Pneumonia); row 7 (Pneumonia) supplies the subset.

expect.base_rate_line: Illustrative base rate (NHAMCS 2022): Shortness of breath -> 25.8% admitted. Dangerous subset (Pneumonia) -> 54.4%, not identifiable at triage. Population reference, not this patient's probability.

cases._why: 'stroke' matches row 5 (Stroke/TIA, no context_condition) -> complaint rate + caveat only.

expect.base_rate_line: Illustrative base rate (NHAMCS 2022): Stroke / TIA -> 53.0% admitted. Population reference, not this patient's probability.
Illustrative base rate (NHAMCS 2022): Syncope (fainting) -> 20.5% admitted. Population reference, not this patient's probability.
Illustrative base rate (NHAMCS 2022): Abdominal pain (all causes) -> 9.1% admitted. Population reference, not this patient's probability.

cases._why: 'neuro' has NO complaint row in condition_reference -> returns None (no base-rate line).
cases._note: Also applies to general, minor_general, minor_injury - none have complaint rows.

cases._why: GUARD (hypothetical seed): a complaint row names a context_condition, but no row has that condition -> diagnosis lookup None -> subset clause skipped. Not reproducible with the shipped CSV (all context_conditions have matching rows); seed a custom row to exercise.

expect.base_rate_line: Illustrative base rate (NHAMCS 2022): Orphan complaint -> 10.0% admitted. Population reference, not this patient's probability.

cases._note: Requires a seeded complaint row with context_condition pointing at a non-existent condition. Documents the None-diagnosis branch.
